notes.title: An Update on Our Full Release
notes.notes:
Project Rot - Updated Demo


Hey everyone!! 



We're making this post to address the date of our final release. Our current demo states our full release will take place August 31st. Unfortunately our release date will be postponed significantly. Our team has made this decision to create the full rot experience for our players and ensure our game is not rushed. 



To make up for this we're working hard to create an update for our current demo. Be sure to look out for this within the next week! This update contains our new combat design, more characters, new cinematics in our first gameplay level "The Shadowed Woods", peaceful ocarina melodies and more time in the Wizard Man's tubular tower. 



The next thing to look forward to will be our Steam Next Fest update, where players will be able to explore some areas in Royal Road Village!



Best, 

Nicole M. (Team Mist)
